test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A paper is folded and cut as shown. How will it appear when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8dc057bcc35eca6d59092a9a2962d9e39d702ce221b8c339ad77921b7a399fb.png]
solution:
Here, we have a paper which is folded three times and then cut it out to get some design on it.

First, we will open the 1st fold and see as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ed1a6647f49003b39d40533db8dba285a1e1e334f8d229f74bbebed0b785648.png] 

So, we can see that we will get the mirror image of 1st part in the 2nd part.

Next, we will open the last part and see, we will get the water image of the 1st half part on to the 2nd half part.

Hence, the correct answer is __**option 1**__.
